# {k} is replaced by each parameter text.
=== sub bas
Sub P({k})
End Sub
=== func bas
Function P({k}) As Long
End Function
=== propget cls

Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Property Get P({k}) As Long
End Property

=== declare bas
Declare Function f Lib "k" ({k}) As Long
=== declsub bas
